metadata.description: Word-by-word J/E/P lexical analysis of the supplied Friedman Torah English word-count file.

main_metric.name: global_surprise_bits
main_metric.definition: n * KL(observed source distribution for word || corpus source prior), base 2
main_metric.formula: sum_s c_s * log2((c_s/n) / (N_s/N)), omitting zero-count terms
main_metric.interpretation: Total bits of evidence that this word is distributed differently across J/E/P than corpus size alone predicts.

source_specific_metric.name: <source>_signed_info_bits
source_specific_metric.definition: signed n * binary KL(source-vs-rest observed share || source-vs-rest corpus prior)
source_specific_metric.interpretation: Positive means enrichment in that source; magnitude incorporates both skew and repetition.

cryptanalytic_metric.name: <source>_woe_bits
cryptanalytic_metric.definition: Jeffreys-corrected log2 odds ratio for occurrence in source versus the other two corpora
cryptanalytic_metric.interpretation: Per-occurrence discriminatory strength; useful beside total evidence because rare exclusive words can have high WoE but little total evidence.

significance.q_value: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all word types
significance.warning: Token-independence is false for continuous texts, so p/q values are descriptive and anti-conservative; the bit metrics are the preferred rankings.

artifact_flag.name: suspected_extraction_fragment
artifact_flag.warning: Heuristic only. Flagged tokens remain in the dataset and metrics; headline tables omit them.
